subject: Song of Storms
text: Playing the Ocarina for the music box man in the windmill teaches the Song of Storms, played with A, down, up, A, down, up.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the crazy guy with the music box in here and then 
while standing in front of him, take out your Ocarina.  He will teach you a 
very special song, the SONG OF STORMS which is played with the following 
combination: A, down, up, A, down, up.

subject: Pocket Egg
text: The Pocket Egg given by the Cucco breeder hatches into a Pocket Cucco after playing the Sun's Song twice.

evidence.quote:
She gives you the POCKET EGG which will hatch 
overnight just like the other egg.  After acquiring it, play the Sun's Song 
once, and then again to make the egg hatch into a POCKET CUCCO.

subject: Cojiro
text: Waking Talon with the Pocket Cucco in Kakariko Village and returning it to the breeder rewards Cojiro.

evidence.quote:
In here you will find Talon sleeping on a bed.  Stand 
beside him with your new Pocket Cucco equipped on one of the C Buttons and use 
it.  Talon should wake up and then when you talk to him, he should mention 
something about going back to the ranch....After speaking with her, use the Pocket Cucco and assuming it woke up Talon, 
it will be happy like she asked.  As a reward for what you have done she gives 
you COJIRO, a special Blue Cucco which has stopped crowing entirely.

subject: Crate
text: Rolling into the crate on the ledge reached by the magic bean platform in the Graveyard yields Piece of Heart 018.

evidence.quote:
Make your way to the northwest area where you planted the sprout as Young Link, there is not a platform here which when stepped on, raises you up to the ledge.  Roll into 
the crate to destroy it and you will get a PIECE OF HEART [018].

subject: Dampe
text: Following Dampe through his underground crypt without falling behind earns a large chest containing the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
If you manage to follow him all the way through to the end 
without being left behind that he places a large treasure chest in front of 
you which contains the HOOKSHOT.

subject: Time Blocks
text: Playing the Song of Time removes the two stacked blocks found past Dampe's race room.

evidence.quote:
There are two blocks in this room piled on top of one another.  What you need 
to do to get past this is play the Song of Time on your Ocarina, (right, A, 
down, right, A, down.)

subject: Dampe
text: Completing Dampe's race in less than one minute rewards Piece of Heart 019.

evidence.quote:
Agree to his race once again, this time we 
are going to do everything we can to finish in under one minute, that is the 
goal....If your time was in fact less than one minute then you are rewarded with the 
PIECE OF HEART [019].

subject: Man on Roof
text: Hookshotting from the Potion Shop roof to the purple roof allows Link to speak to the man sitting there for Piece of Heart 020.

evidence.quote:
From where I told you to stand, near the wall between the 
stairs and the gate, fire your Hookshot at the little bit of red roof you can 
see from here and you should be able to pull yourself up onto the Potion Shop.  
Now run to the other side of the roof and hook across to the purple roof with 
the guy sitting on it.  Speak to him and he will give you PIECE OF HEART 
[020].

subject: Gold Skulltula 044
text: Gold Skulltula 044 crawls at night on the high wall of the house attached to the chicken coop in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Climb the stairs and hook onto the roof of the House of Skulltula.  From there 
turn around and face south, hook onto the house with the chicken coop attached 
to it.  During the night you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [044] crawling around 
on the wall up here.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course
text: Finishing the Lon Lon Ranch horse obstacle course in 50 Seconds or better awards a cow delivered to Link's house in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
When you 
speak to Malon while riding the horse two times, she will offer to let you 
race and obstacle course.  The time to beat is 50 Seconds and she says that if 
you beat it you will get a present....Assuming you 
get a time of 0:49 or better then Malon will give you a present, she says it 
is too big to give you so she'll have it delivered to your home.  The present 
is in fact a whole cow that now lives in your house in Kokiri Forest.

subject: Gold Skulltula 045
text: Gold Skulltula 045 is on the wall past the arch on the path leading up to Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Return to Hyrule Castle town and 
make your way through the Market up toward Ganon's Castle.  Follow the path 
around and under the arch.  When you get through the arch turn around and 
there you will see the GOLD SKULLTULA [045] crawling around on the wall, get 
it using your Hookshot.

subject: Odd Mushroom
text: Using Cojiro to wake the sleeping man in the Lost Woods yields the Odd Mushroom, which expires if not delivered within three minutes.

evidence.quote:
equip the blue Cucco 
Cojiro on one of your C-Buttons and then use it while standing in front of the 
man.  He offers to give you an item which will go bad if you don't deliver it 
quickly, I think we have time to make a quick detour.  Accept his offer and he 
gives you the ODD MUSHROOM.  You now have three minutes to get to the Potion 
Shop in Kakariko Village.

subject: Odd Medicine
text: Trading the Odd Mushroom to the witch behind the Kakariko Potion Shop grants the Odd Medicine.

evidence.quote:
Climb the stairs and enter the other door back there, it will take you to a 
witch.  Use the Odd Mushroom while standing in front of her and she will give 
you the ODD MEDICINE.

subject: Poacher's Saw
text: Giving the Odd Medicine to the girl where the sleeping man was in the Lost Woods rewards the Poacher's Saw.

evidence.quote:
Go to where the man was sitting previously and there you 
will find a small girl.  Stand in front of her and use the Odd Medicine to 
acquire the POACHER'S SAW.

subject: Mido
text: Playing Saria's Song for the elf boy blocking the path past the sequence of right, left, right, left makes him move.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance of the Lost Woods again, make a right, then a left, then a 
right, then a left.  When you try to make that last left, you'll find there is 
a small elf boy blocking the path similar to back at the very beginning of the 
game.  Getting by him is simple, simply stand beside the boy and pull out your 
Ocarina.  Play Saria's Song for him and he will move.

subject: Gold Skulltula 046
text: Riding the Magic Bean platform in the Lost Woods brings Link up to Gold Skulltula 046.

evidence.quote:
In the area after this 
make a left again and you will come across that small part of the forest where 
you planted a Magic Bean when you were a kid.  Step on the Magic Bean platform 
and it will take you up to a GOLD SKULLTULA [046].

subject: Club Moblin
text: The club-wielding leader at the end of Sacred Forest Meadow alternates slamming his club left, right, and left, and dies to three sword slashes.

evidence.quote:
Make your way through this area to the end where you 
will find kind of the boss of these enemies, he wields a large club.  This 
enemy slams it down on the left, then the right, then left and that's his 
pattern.  It takes three sword slashes to kill him.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: Reaching the top of the stairs past the club moblin in Sacred Forest Meadow triggers a scene where Link learns the Minuet of Forest.

evidence.quote:
Once you get past this 
enemy there is a scene at the top of the stairs.  You will learn the MINUET OF 
FOREST here.
